description: Soft chime: pleasant highlight, step done.
UI click: quick cuts, list items, button presses.
Digital glitch: tech, hacking, jarring cut.
Deep bass hit: shocking fact, big reveal, section start.
Single key press: text or command appearing.
Phone notification: message, alert, something happened.
Clean ping: mark a key word.
Bubble pop: small reveal, list item appearing.
Rising tension: start before a reveal so it peaks on the cut.
Magic shimmer: something special or valuable appears.
Keyboard typing: coding or writing scenes. Keep volume low.
Big dramatic whoosh: major scene change only.
